reviews.title: Problem with opening app
reviews.text:
Aslamualikum. Why it have problems when I open the app? Please fix this app so I can easily open the app and see inside. Even I can’t get notifications. Nothing. I am very disappointed. 
Salam.

reviews.title: Ads ads and ads.
reviews.text: Used to be a decent app but then they just spammed it with ads. Every option you select triggers a new ad where you have to wait 5-7 seconds just to pull up a feature — want to check qibla? Wait 5 seconds for an ad. Want to check the prayer times? Wait 5 seconds for an ad. Want to pull up a new location? Wait 5 seconds for an ad. Used this app for a few years but now sadly deleting it. Lots of apps out there with fewer or no ads.

reviews.title: Ads are not religious
reviews.text: I’m sorry to say that this app has become so obsessed with adverts (and assuming they get paid for it). They’ve sold their souls on the back of our religion.☹️😔

reviews.title: Advert infested app despite paid subscription
reviews.text: I have been using this app for many years now but it’s constantly plagued with obscene advert’s despite the fact that I have been paying for subscription, besides I have reached out to the developer but I have never got the fix to the problem yet.
